reuse.why: Computes expectedAmount with the existing shared getScheduleAmount helper, the same one forecast-schedules and schedules/app already use for 'furthest from zero'.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the field is one call in scheduleModel.toExternal.

placement.why: The field is added in the API model mapping (api-models.ts scheduleModel), where the API shape of a schedule is defined.

scope.why: Only the API type, its mapping and excluding the derived field from schedule-create input.

maintainability.why: Tiny, derived from the single shared amount rule, so any future change to that rule reaches the API automatically.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getScheduleAmount from shared/schedules rather than its own range logic.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the diff adds a single call to the existing helper.
